controllerCompatibility.interpretation: Worker, baseline and harness files are unchanged. Controller-only edits are accepted only when all consumed presets, calendar-function definitions and evaluated horizon lengths are identical. Both controller file hashes are retained.

purpose: Describe simulation seed variability and selected assumption sensitivity; no empirical uncertainty calibration or preferred outcome assertion.

evidenceStatus.interpretation: Coverage counts apply to fields, not to model validity. Historical all-trip shares do not calibrate work-trip mode choices.

design.scale: Full committed resident weight and employer count; no reduced-scale substitute.
design.pairedContrast: Bus-priority minus reference under the same seed and assumptions. Branching can consume different random draws; equal seeds alone do not guarantee eventwise common random numbers.
design.travelObservation: Pool completed workday commuter observations over the final observation window. Exclude retained weekend assignments. Unserved demand has a separate denominator.
design.financialObservation: Final cross-section of each current cohort's latest financial account. Continuing cohorts retain the last closed month; annual demographic replacements contribute new opening budget estimates and zero prior-period saving/drawdown. Counts and represented weights of both account bases are recorded per run. This mixed snapshot is distinct from a wholly realized monthly ledger and from the pooled travel window.
design.seedSummary: Mean, observed minimum/maximum, sample standard deviation and sign counts across independent seeds. Small-sample spread is not a confidence or prediction interval.
design.sensitivity: One parameter at a time at -25% and +25% of its base value, paired at the first seed. These are chosen stress ranges, not evidence-based parameter bounds. Cross-parameter interactions are not covered.
design.initialization: No warm-up discarded and no equilibrium claim. Results include adjustment from the synthetic opening allocation.

financialObservationBasis.classificationRule: lastAccountedDays > 0 denotes a settled account; zero or missing days denotes an opening estimate.
financialObservationBasis.interpretation: Cross-section of current cohorts: continuing cohorts retain their latest settled account; demographic replacements supply opening estimates, not realized December spending. Replacement saving/drawdown is reset to zero.
